notesStmt.note: This manuscript was likely written sometime in late 1884 or the first half of 1885.

This manuscript is housed with a series of notes and drafts of the poem cluster "Fancies at Navesink," which was first published in the Nineteenth Century magazine in August 1885. One of the poems in the cluster was titled "Last of Ebb, and Daylight Waning." It is not clear if this brief manuscript is a possible title for the whole cluster or a draft title for that particular poem. There are several other manuscripts that contain similar titles, seemingly all related to the "Fancies at Navesink" cluster.
